finding.statement: Three new malware families were detected in 2026: LummaStealer, UNMAPPED:Win32/Kryptik.gen, and Akira.
caveats: Summed across products. One attack can be seen by more than one product (e.g. email gateway and EDR), so this may overcount attacks.
Some vendor malware names have no common family mapping; see unmapped_malware().
